title: Ramsey number R(6,8), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_6 and no blue K_8; it shows R(6,8) > n. The best known lower bound is R(6,8) >= 135, so a colouring of K_134 is known and one of K_135 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.

best_known.source: R(6,8) >= 135: Cremer, arXiv:2610.12122; Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 printed 134; read 5 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Small Ramsey Numbers (S. Radziszowski), EJC Dynamic Survey DS1
provenance.revision: revision 18 (24 Apr 2026) and later sources named

score: n, the number of vertices of the colouring; it proves R(6,8) >= n + 1 (larger is better)
